name: Unquant
description: Serves delayed and end-of-day market data, company fundamentals, analyst ratings, financial news, US macro indicators, and US Congress trade disclosures over a keyless remote MCP endpoint.

skills.name: Market Quotes & History
skills.description: Returns delayed and end-of-day quotes, OHLCV price history, and symbol search via market_quote, market_price_history, and market_symbol_search.

skills.name: Company Fundamentals
skills.description: Pulls company profiles, financial statements, earnings, analyst ratings, and ETF holdings through the market_* fundamentals tools.

skills.name: Financial News Retrieval
skills.description: Fetches stock-specific and general financial news, article bodies, and news impact analysis via news_stock, news_general, news_impacts, and news_article.

skills.name: US Macro Indicators
skills.description: Reads US macroeconomic indicators, release calendars, and a themed current-conditions summary via macro_indicator, macro_calendar, and macro_current_conditions.

skills.name: Congress Trade Disclosures
skills.description: Queries US Congress stock trade disclosures and aggregates by member or ticker via politics_us_congress_trades and politics_us_congress_aggregate.

skills.name: Dataset Catalog Browsing
skills.description: Lists, describes, searches, and previews the available datasets so an agent can discover coverage before querying, via the datasets_* and catalog_* tools.
